title: LTX 2.3 Reference to Video enhancer (recipe r2v): right picture roles, real descriptions, green Stage 1
description: Follow-up to MPI-1060 (Fabio, 2026-10-11: 'doesn't that sound like a fail?'). The r2v enhancer draft mislabels pictures ('rocking chair in <Picture 2>' became '<Picture 2> a rocking chair' instead of the room), writes thin descriptions ('<Picture 1> a man'), sometimes gives <Audio 1> a picture line, and is not green on Stage 1 (with pictures 9/12). Fix the wording, get --ref-tiers green twice, then Fabio renders real clips (Stage 2). The no-pictures case is MPI-1081's. See plan.md.
